script_text: ARIES ALERT — Mars, your ruling planet, ignites a fire in your 1st House this week, and nothing will be the same. Early week, Mercury sextile Jupiter in your 3rd House fuels bold conversations Monday through Wednesday, but watch Tuesday when the Moon squares your natal Mars — tension rises, so avoid confrontations. The turning point arrives Thursday as Venus trines your 10th House of career, opening a golden window for recognition and financial opportunity. By Friday through Sunday, the Sun conjuncts your Midheaven, amplifying your public presence and love prospects — someone new may enter your orbit. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury sextile Jupiter sharpens your mind, while Tuesday is your worst day due to the Moon-Mars square sparking impulsive clashes. This week, channel your Aries fire into career moves, not arguments. Follow for daily updates.
